verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own Vertex AI page says it offers a first-party platform to "Build, scale, govern, and optimize enterprise grade AI agents" and a full-stack foundation for agentic systems. That is direct product-level support for a managed agent home, but it is landing-page copy rather than documentation of a specific runtime or orchestration service. The MCP server and Toolbox items connect tools to agents, which is a different capability, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: named agent runtime/orchestration service documentation (deployment, sessions, memory, scaling), GA/lifecycle status, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, agents have a managed home — first-party agent runtimes/orchestration services shipped and documented, not just a blog vision

citations.quote: Build, scale, govern, and optimize enterprise grade AI agents
It provides the full-stack foundation and extensive developer choice you need to transform your applications and workflows into powerful agentic systems at global scale.
